mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 4.0% is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising input costs (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), supply chain disruptions cause corporate margin pressures, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the regime condition, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% and remains above this level for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that dampens equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS > 3.5% is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a labor market deterioration that reduces household income and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), supply constraints lead to higher input costs and reduced corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the regime condition, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03.
